scope: Independent read-only boundary review of scenario caption corrections and live protocol response ownership. No tests/browser/database/runtime calls and no tracked edits.

boundary_reviews.reason: Playback follows meta guided:<job_id> to the persisted ExecutionSession, validates session identity, order and order-line membership, then returns its saved fault. It does not use current session.job_id, dropdown state, a later review fault or the latest job. Earlier lines retain their own authority link.
Uses existing store readonly_connect(mode=ro/query_only) with guaranteed close. No GuidedStore initialization or table bootstrap is added to playback.

Missing marker/row, invalid session, mismatched session/order/line produce absent scenario metadata. Frontend does not relabel absence as Happy path; unknown recorded fault is explicitly unrecognized. Explicit saved null is separately labeled baseline and does not replace the job outcome.

boundary_reviews.assessment: No actionable defect found in the supplied per-job API path
boundary_reviews.reason: API clips contain only that job timeline. Frontend fallback searches a matching-job FAULT_INJECTED only before the first terminal/uncertain boundary, preventing later observation/reconciliation faults from becoming the execution caption. It returns a neutral missing label if none qualifies.

Caption derives from each saved clip, not current selector. Delivery playback calls per-job playback and reports the distinct labels as mixed when needed. Scenario labeling remains separate from status/outcome.
Six integration faults receive defined purpose/watch text, while unsupported selections retain the neutral unsupported fallback. The new tests explicitly distinguish both behaviors.

boundary_reviews.boundary: Session and command change resets live text
boundary_reviews.reason: accept resets on session or command ID change, including same-session move to another job command. resetLive increments independent generation, cancels prior timer, clears prior presentation and releases the old in-flight flag so a current poll can start.

boundary_reviews.boundary: Late old response or error cannot overwrite new command
boundary_reviews.reason: Successful response and error presentation require matching live generation, session ID and command ID. A returned payload naming another command becomes unavailable evidence without exposing its unrelated events.

boundary_reviews.boundary: Late old finally cannot release new poll or create timer
boundary_reviews.reason: The same current() guard owns pollingLive release and timer scheduling. Completion of the old promise cannot set the new poll idle or schedule an obsolete timer.

boundary_reviews.boundary: Clear, load, authorization and socket ownership
boundary_reviews.assessment: No actionable defect found in changed paths
boundary_reviews.reason: Clear/load invalidate live generation; polling requires physical authorization and repeated polling requires current stage16. WebSocket message handling now checks saved session ownership as well as generation.
